description.value: The Marquise is a six-story condominium lodge perched on Blackcomb Benchlands in Whistler, offering ski-in/out access across the street. It features a large hot tub under a glass dome with mountain views, a heated outdoor pool open year-round, and a fitness room. Touring cyclists will find it a comfortable base in the heart of the Whistler corridor.
